title: Dark GUI + black-and-white textures + abstract paintings
description: This resource pack darkens the GUI to black, gives a few other textures a black-and-white theming, changes painting textures to a bunch of abstract art, and gives axes a better look.
body:
This texture pack darkens the GUI to black and dark gray. It gives some parts of the gui—and some blocks and items, such as the enchanting table, trident, elytra, etc.—a matching black-and white theme.

Additionally, this pack slightly retextures axes (giving them more curved blades) and swords (adding a bit of flair to the hilt).

And out of left field, this pack replaces all paintings except the sunset with mostly brightly-colored original abstract art. Idk, I just wanted to use the art in something ig.
